events.summary: Created the package, PySide6 shell, data models, JSON persistence, synthetic sample, geometry, loads, soil, bearing, settlement, piles, raft, structural checks, rebar/BBS, selector, exports, GUI pages and initial tests.

Added ETABS/SAFE import, CPT data, custom raft outlines, combined-footing checks, pile-cap strut-and-tie, crack width, uplift, downdrag, Broms lateral capacity, P-M interaction, rotated geometry and the angled-wall sample.
Ran a whole-build Ponytail audit and confirmed 17 findings: 8 Must fix, 7 Should fix and 2 Nice to have.

Fixed all 17 findings, including raft differential units, pile-cap anchorage, strip/combined status and flexure, reaction CSV replacement, Broms strengths, rotation projections, CPT import, net-pressure settlement, mat steel weight, PDF raft moments, pile-cap flexure reporting, rotated site plans, lateral tokens, direct end bearing, merged remarks and dead-code removal.
Added SI/US interchangeability with a conversion registry, GUI bindings, import/export/report conversion, cost-rate quantities, dynamic labels and JSON info.units semantics.
Updated README and .opencode context/plan/todo/progression/ponyfix for the completed audit and unit system; regenerated samples.

Completed the final documentation consistency pass and reran verification: 91 tests passed, smoke exit 0, compileall and unused-import scan clean; samples showed 8 results, 7 selected, all CHECK, RAFT-1 alternative, 5 warnings and 12 report lines.
Created the public GitHub repository with MIT license, owner attribution, description and discovery topics; pushed the initial 56-file release.
Added .zipignore and archive/backup rules to .gitignore; committed and pushed the backup ignore configuration.

Created a local zip backup, then moved it from a sibling backups/ folder into the project root as requested; verified a clean restore with 91 passing tests, smoke exit 0 and matching sample checksums.
Added the .xcontext durable knowledge base: central map, nine focused markdown records and four JSON indexes for state, decisions, files and timeline.
